test_pybind11_list_bindings: test the pybind11 list bindings by calling get_list and print_list to verify list access and mutation
test_pybind11_dict_bindings: test the pybind11 dict bindings by calling get_dict and print_dict to verify dictionary access and iteration
test_pybind11_string_conversions: test the pybind11 string conversion functions str_from_string, str_from_bytes, str_from_object, and str_format
test_pybind11_capsule_destructor: test the pybind11 capsule lifecycle by creating and deleting capsules with destructors to verify cleanup
test_pybind11_accessor_api: test the pybind11 accessor API by calling accessor_api and accessor_assignment to verify attribute and item access
